description: Roads by country (Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team, on HDX) is a series of datasets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Road network across the region tagged highway=: motorways, residential streets, service roads, footways, and trails. Useful for routing, accessibility analysis, and evacuation planning. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. Coverage: 238 countries and territories, one dataset each (for example Andorra, United Arab Emirates, Afghanistan, Antigua and Barbuda). The portal lists 239 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 7 resource(s) in GEOPACKAGE, HTML, JSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
